afirmacao.enunciado: O UniProt/Swiss-Prot (Tox-Prot) anota função para Snake venom metalloproteinase batroxase de Bothrops atrox.
afirmacao.passagem: Snake venom zinc metalloproteinase with strong fibrinolytic activity, as well as fibrinogenolytic activity (PubMed:22483847, PubMed:26273288). On fibrin, degrades the beta-chain and the gamma-gamma homodimer, without affecting the alpha-chain and the monomeric gamma-chain (PubMed:22483847). On fibrinogen, degrades the alpha-chain (FGA) and, more slowly, the beta-chain (FGB), without affecting the gamma-chain (PubMed:22483847, PubMed:26273288). Degrades components of the extracellular matrix (ECM) (type IV collagen alpha-1 chain (COL4A1) and alpha-2 chain (COL4A2), fibronectin (FN1), and laminin in Matrigel) (PubMed:22483847). Also degrades plasminogen (PLG) in fragments from 20 to 38 kDa (PubMed:22483847). Is able to degrade fibrin clots (thrombolytic activity) independently of plasminogen activation (PubMed:22483847, PubMed:27876598). Induces minor mast cell degranulation (PubMed:26072684). Is also able to activate the complement system by direct proteolytic action on several components (C3, C4,Factor B and C1-Inhibitor), generating anaphylatoxins (C3a, C4a and C5a) and affecting the three activation pathways (CP, LP and AP) (PubMed:27846429). In vivo, shows many effects. Induces the recruitment of leukocytes, mainly neutrophils, to the toxin injection site (PubMed:28327442). Induces release of inflammatory mediators, including IL-6, IL-1beta, IL-10, and prostaglandine E2 (PGE2), at the toxin injection site (PubMed:28327442). Induces edema and hyperalgesia (1 hour after injection) mostly due to release of histamine, leukotrienes and serotonin (PubMed:26072684). Shows weak hemorrhagic activity (PubMed:22483847)
